newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt looking at special tax rebate - paper.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt looking at special tax rebate - paper.

text.p: The Australian government is considering introducing a special tax rebate on savings for low and middle-income earners to boost national savings, a newspaper report said on Tuesday.

The Australian newspaper reported cabinet this week would look at a range of options for lifting savings using the A$4.3 billion of funds set aside by the former Labor government to pay for a second round of tax cuts.
The former government's planned tax cuts, the second of two rounds, were to be paid into workers' compulsory pension funds, or superannuation, between 1998 and 2000.
